blocks.text: British actor Robert Pattinson’s role as James Bond will cement him as one of Hollywood’s most versatile and bankable superstars, but he will have to juggle two of the industry’s biggest franchises. The London-born 40-year-old will now be in the incredibly rare position of fronting both the current Batman series — which he started in 2022 — and the new Bond movie. He spent part of this year shooting “The Batman: Part II” with director Matt Reeves, which is being produced by Warner Bros and is slated to hit screens in February 2028.
